title: Module Worker
description: Long-lived logical identity of one ES Module Worker application. The Form fixes the ES module worker ABI by identity: handlers are exported module functions receiving typed events and a binding environment. Code, configuration, and bindings live on Worker Version revisions; traffic selection lives on Worker Deployments.
